name: Robot Trains
description: Set in the "Train World" where all citizens are trains. However, among the residents there are special trains that can transform into robots, the Robot Trains! Featuring our 5 train heroes, with special powers: Kay, Alf, Duck, Selly and Victor - and their exciting adventures. Can the Robot Trains save the village from the evil dark forces that be?

videos.title: The Adventure Begins
videos.overview: The Train World is having a busy period, building railroads between continents. The Intercontinental Railroad construction is to revitalize the isolated continents by installing connecting railroads. The main supervisor of the construction, Kay, begins the construction despite worries from other trains. But Duke, who is to work together with Kay, betrays him and tries to steal his magnetic engine.

videos.title: Duke is a Liar
videos.overview: Duke returns to the Train World and lies to everyone that Kay is lost due to an unfortunate accident. But Kay also makes it back, and Duke's lie is revealed! To fulfill his evil scheme, Duke forcefully tries to take over the Train World. But with his last ounce of strength, Kay stops Duke using his lethal combat technique, Maximum Overdrive.

videos.title: Lost Memories
videos.overview: After a long rest, Kay wakes up, clueless to who or where he is. Confused, Kay leaves his base and arrives at the Fountain Plaza. There, everyone welcomes Kay, but Kay doesn't remember anything about his friends. He goes sullen after listening to how great he used to be, and his friends decide to help him get back to his old self.

videos.title: Runaway Virus Train
videos.overview: As the power of the Train World becomes weaker, viruses spring up and begin to infect the inhabitants. If infected, the trains lose control of their engines and run until they completely exhaust their energy. While Selly searches for the vaccine, Kay and Duck enter the infected zone, Area D. The virus has already spread throughout the region, putting trains in danger.

videos.title: Run, Kay!
videos.overview: A virus enters the system in Area D, and the area's control unit malfunctions. To fix the problem, Kay has to run faster than the flow of energy and manually adjust all levers along the train tracks. Confident about his speed, Kay thinks this will be an easy task, but a gorilla speedometer surprises Kay, chasing him as it grows bigger and faster, collecting energy from the tracks.

videos.title: Here Comes Alf
videos.overview: After Kay gets his upgrade with Experience Points from completing the Area D restoration task, he decides to reopen the railroad tunnel to the Mountain Area, where Alf is trapped. With everyone cheering for him, Kay opens the tunnel gate that leads to the Mountain Area, but his attempt is hindered by a fiercely cold wind from the tunnel that freezes the Fountain Plaza completely.

videos.title: Repairing the Clock Tower
videos.overview: After using all his energy while opening the tunnel to the Mountain Area, Kay collapses as he barely makes it there. Alf finds Kay in need of assistance but doesn't step up to help him. Following Kay into the tunnel, Selly and Duck finally reunite with Alf. While Duck brings injured Kay back to Kay's base, Selly learns that Alf was able to survive because his friends had made sacrifices.

videos.title: Kay and Alf
videos.overview: When the avalanche starts to fall, Alf, Jeffrey, Selly and Duck quickly search for ways to protect the Mountain Area. Kay regains consciousness and helps Alf trying to stop the falling rocks, while the others build barriers. Alf still resents Kay for putting his friends in danger, and the two keep on arguing on duty. After watching Kay eagerly trying to save the Mountain Area,

videos.title: A Recovered Friendship
videos.overview: Through various experiences, Kay successfully continues to receive upgrades. Feeling good and confident, he goes to the Fountain Plaza and finds out that everyone is praising Alf for being so helpful. While Alf is busy fixing things, Kay also wants to help others but keeps on causing problems instead. Kay becomes discouraged as Alf proves to be a better leader than he is.

videos.title: Janne and Kay
videos.overview: Kay decides to train harder after finding out that he needs more experience points to earn higher level upgrades and starts working on his traction technique. While helping Kay train, Selly notices that Janne likes Kay and that she wants to help him. Selly assigns Kay's training to Janne while she goes to install a weather station with Alf.

videos.title: Selly's Special Training
videos.overview: Kay loses control over his units because his units received upgrades after special training. He needs extra training to tame them and quickly upgrade his main system. Selly develops a simulator that synchronizes with Kay's base system to train him in virtual space. Not knowing Selly's hard work, Kay fights back and finally manages to take control over his disobedient units in his dreams.

videos.title: Alf Speaks His Mind
videos.overview: Kay finds out that Alf has been training hard in the early mornings. He follows Alf to the Mountain Area and sees him running too fast on the rugged mountain railroads. When Kay asks him for the reason, Alf speaks his mind. Alf believes that he could have saved Kay and completed constructing the Intercontinental Railroad if he had gone with Kay instead of Duke.

videos.title: Uninvited Guest
videos.overview: Everyone needs more training to open the connecting tunnel to Area V so Selly installs a virtual simulation program to Kay, Alf and Duck's main system. The three Robot Trains begin their training in their dream: Fighting against monster cakes, climbing up a high mountain and completing other unusual tasks. Then Duke appears in the virtual space.

videos.title: Close Victory
videos.overview: Duke in the virtual space is unimaginably strong. After losing connection with Selly, Kay, Alf and Duck are completely exhausted, fighting against Duke. On the other end, Selly is puzzled that the program has gone out of control. While Alf wakes up from his dream, Kay and Duck are still trapped in the virtual space with the formidable foe.

videos.title: Go, Robot Trains!
videos.overview: The Train World is downgraded from Kay's setback and the Area V, which requires a large amount of energy to be opened, remains unlocked. Hence the trains hold the Train Race, their tradition, which allows energy to be delivered evenly throughout the Train World. In order to win the race, the participant must receive cargos from the other trains, while running a lap around the whole Train World.

videos.title: The Festival Day
videos.overview: Kay and Alf tie with eleven cargos each, which they have received from helping other trains. With Kay's Base as the last section of the race, Kay and Alf fight for each other's cargos but end up giving all their cargos to Duck who was strolling at the bottom of the hill when the law of inertia works in Duck's favor.

videos.title: Duke Awakens
videos.overview: It's the day of the opening ceremony for Kay to finally open the tunnel to Area V. Everyone is in the festive mood, but Kay seems nervous because he will be put to the test as to check how much he has improved. Sensing something strange on the night of the Train Race, Jeffrey is gone to check on Duke in his jail. As everyone cheers Kay on, Duke shows up at the ceremony.

videos.title: Hang in There, Kay!
videos.overview: Kay and his friends battle against Duke. Even after Alf ties Duke up, Duck shoots his water guns at him and Selly uses the G-force Nanobombs to help Kay fight Duke, all their efforts are useless against the powerful enemy. But when Kay and his friends refuse to give up, Duke starts up his engine to suck in all the energy from the Fountain Plaza and causes a blackout.

videos.title: Victor Arrives
videos.overview: To make matters worse after all his friends have fallen, Kay's vision sensor is broken. Jeffrey tries to fight off Duke but he's no match for Duke. Not being able to see, furious Kay lunges at Duke, but Duke sends a shock to Kay's engine, making him immobile. Alf, Selly and Duck come to Kay's rescue, combining their skills and weapons to protect Kay.

videos.title: Victor the Venerated Train
videos.overview: As the tunnel to Area V reopens, Victor is back. Victor visits the gatekeepers of each area who are his old students. Watching everyone welcoming Victor, Kay realizes that Victor is very much respected around the Train World and feels sad that he doesn't have any memory of Victor. After meeting everyone, Victor takes Kay to meet Stella, the fortune teller.

videos.title: The Secret of Alpha Train
videos.overview: Kay listens to Stella's story about the primordial train called the Alpha Train. Stella warns Kay that soon, darkness will dawn upon them. Kay is doubtful but Victor shows him the proof of the Alpha Train's existence, the cargo of the Alpha Train that has landed in Area V. Victor explains to Kay that Area V was able to survive after it was shut off from the Fountain Plaza.

videos.title: Duke Speaks His Mind
videos.overview: Kay and his friends realize that Duke has acted strangely because of a virus. To treat Duke, Kay and the gang must log into Duke's system and remove the mutant virus themselves. With the help of Selly, Kay, Alf, Duck and Victor enter Duke's system.

videos.title: Kay and Duke
videos.overview: While Kay and his friends are searching for the virus inside Duke's memories, they find Duke's memory of the day before the opening ceremony of the Intercontinental Railroad, where a virus infected Duke's system and turned him evil. They now know that Duke was a victim of the virus. Fighting the mutant virus monsters, Kay and the friends get closer to the central part of Duke's engine.

videos.title: Kay's Strange Training
videos.overview: Duke finally comes back to the Fountain Plaza after his recovery, but everyone is still scared of him. Kay asks Duke to go training with him, but it is actually Kay's scheme to help Duke earn trust back from the other trains. Up on the mountain, Kay and Duke pick up things that the others might like, but the other trains still can't believe Duke's good intentions.

videos.title: The Time Tunnel
videos.overview: Kay loses control of his engine and starts to run too fast, causing space-time to warp and twist. Kay visits the Fountain Plaza and notices that everyone is moving very slowly. Duke is the only one who realized what's happening to Kay and comes to help. When Duke tells Kay that no one can see or hear him because he's moving too fast, the Time Tunnel opens up.

videos.title: Another World
videos.overview: Kay arrives at the Central, but the atmosphere is somewhat different than before. His friends act weird and seem to be afraid of him. Kay hears from Duck of what he had least expected. In this world, Kay is a betrayer who interrupted the opening of the tunnels and shut down Duke's engine. In a nutshell, it becomes clear that Kay had arrived in a whole different Train World.

videos.title: Victor is in Danger
videos.overview: Due to the prolonged isolation period, Area V's energy level is unstable, and the snow starts melting, causing the Ice Cave to collapse on Victor while he is investigating the cave. Kay and Stella save Victor, but Victor needs Selly's help immediately. But because of a rise in the temperature, the entire Area V is melting, hindering Alf, Duck, Selly and Duke to get to Victor.

videos.title: All for One and One for All
videos.overview: Everyone safely makes it to Victor's Base. There, Selly connects Victor's engine with Kay's while repairing Victor. Meanwhile, Duck is skating on a frozen lake when suddenly, the ice on the lake melts and all the water evaporates! Alf and Duke discover what has caused the situation and head out to find the source.

videos.title: Faltering Friendship
videos.overview: One morning, a train is found thrown off the track, all out energy. While everyone watches him worriedly, the train wakes up, pointing the finger at Duke as the attacker. Everyone starts to suspect Duke again and asks him for an explanation. Kay fights for Duke's innocence, but Alf and Duck also start to get suspicious of Duke. At last, Duke declares that he'll get locked up.

videos.title: The Attack of the Virus
videos.overview: Duke's duplicates show up in the Fountain Plaza. It turns out the virus has duplicated Duke while it was invading Duke's system. Victor, Alf, Duck and Selly fight against the duplicates, and Kay and Jeffrey join their effort when they get back. Meanwhile, Duke, locked-up in the cell, senses that something has gone wrong.

videos.title: Train World is in Danger
videos.overview: While fighting Duke's duplicates, Kay and his friends realize something odd. Even though the engines of the Duke's duplicates have ceased to operate, they are still moving. It turns out Duke's duplicates are using the energy from the Fountain Plaza to activate themselves, and because of that, other trains cannot recharge properly.

videos.title: To the New World
videos.overview: All the trains evacuate to Area V, and the Robot Trains block the tunnel that connects to the Fountain Plaza. But Duke's duplicates penetrate and come through the tunnel, endangering everyone in Area V. Then Duke arrives to Area V just in time. It turns out Becky has unlocked Duke while everyone evacuated. Only thing that can stop Duke's duplicates is the energy coming from the Alpha Train.

videos.title: Emergency, Somebody help
videos.overview: Kay, Alf, Victor, Genie, Maxie, and Gary are going on with their daily tasks enjoying a peaceful day at the Railwatch Headquarters. Then, a sudden emergency occurs! There is a report that Mikhail is speeding towards the Energy Volcano.

videos.title: Yeah, Waterland Waterpark
videos.overview: Today is the grand opening of the Water Park in WaterLand, but a shark suddenly spoils the event!

videos.title: No, Kevin, Not Again
videos.overview: Mountain Land's lumber camp railer Kevin starts dreaming of becoming one of the RailWatch members after seeing Alf, a RailWatch member rescue a railer.

videos.title: Leave it to her, Genie the Detective
videos.overview: Windland's Novice Pilot's bag is gone! Without a bag, you can't collect windland energy. Detective Genie comes out to solve the difficult case.

videos.title: Maxie can do it, Maxie Power
videos.overview: Even the youngest Railwatcher Maxie has worries of her own. How come Kay, Alf, Victor, and Genie all have unique talents, but Maxie doesn't?

videos.title: Oh, Victor, Mr. Romantic
videos.overview: Victor comes across an edelweiss, which does not usually grow in sizzling hot places, in the field of Windland. Victor decides to plant the edelweiss in a pot and look after it carefully.

videos.title: Let Gary's Wisdom Shine
videos.overview: Gary and Dolo are once again busy playing chess with each other. The mischievous trio, Mos, Dos, and Duke get a special magnetic hat from TrainX. They come up with a daring plan to sneak into the Railwatch headquarters and steal energy balls.

videos.title: Snap, Stay Away From That Camera
videos.overview: The mischievous trio Mos, Dos, and Duke find an odd looking camera on the street. Dos takes a picture of Igor who was passing by. After the photo, the chronically grumpy Igor suddenly turns into a kind soul. Maybe this is a magic camera!

videos.title: A Day in Alf's Life
videos.overview: Alf does not know how to say no. As always, he is having a busy day helping trains and Railers all over RailWorld. However, there seem to be an unusual amount of trains looking for Alf's help today.

videos.title: He Is Not Angry, He Is Just Victor
videos.overview: Railwatch Victor cares about the railers deeply, but on the surface he seems very cold. Windland railers, startled by Victor's cold words, are so scared of him. Then, a sudden gust of wind blows, and collapses the Windmill. Only Victor can save them now.

videos.title: Go, Kay, Rescue Duck
videos.overview: Kay is afraid of water and envious of Duck, a train that can move freely on water. So, Genie makes "Storm Slider," a hover-board that enables him to run on water.

videos.title: Maxie and Bug, Good Friends
videos.overview: Maxie, who is afraid of bugs, must save the fireflies Mos, Dos, and Duke captured inside the Energyball Capsule!

videos.title: This Is Bad, Find Becky
videos.overview: When Selly looks away for one second, Becky suddenly disappears!

videos.title: Miss you, Tony, Thank you, Genie
videos.overview: During his mission to climb up to a high mountain and fix a weather radar, Alf gets injured. His old backpack launcher is completely broken too. Genie creates a new shiny equipment, Spider Pack, to replace it.

videos.title: Run, Luca, Run
videos.overview: Reckless railer 'Luca' is a well known troublemaker. Everyone tries to catch him, but no one can seem to keep up.

videos.title: Meet Jose, The New Railwatcher
videos.overview: A Waterland train, Jose, always puts safety first. As usual, he was holding a safty education to the Railers, but with an unexpected accident, a Railwatch badge gets stuck on Jose. The Railwatch badge's special power allows Jose to transform from a train to robot, just like the Railwatch members.

videos.title: The Strongest Ever, Victor's Upgrade
videos.overview: Seeing Victor work so hard with his mine excavation work, Genie develops a Wild Hammer Drill that can make his work easier.

videos.title: Only Once a Year, Firework Festival
videos.overview: Today is RailWorld's yearly Firework Festival Day. Genie's firework creations of all the beautiful lands light up the night sky. However, there are someone not happy with Genie's fantastic fireworks.

videos.title: A Shadow in the Dark, Train X
videos.overview: Scientist TrainX does not usually show himself. Mos, Dos, and Duke continue to fail at bringing back the Energyball, so Train X takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Surprise Energy Combination
videos.overview: Genie continues to fail at Energy Combination, but with her experience at the Firework Festival, she succeeds at creating the "Roasty Flamy." With the warm Roasty Flamy, Moutain railers shivering with the cold weather will be able to enjoy a nice toasty day. Of course, Dos, Mos, and Duke would not miss out this chance for trouble, vigilantly looking for the opportunity to steal the Roasty Flamy.

videos.title: No, No Kay Cannot Come In
videos.overview: Kay accidently ruins Victor's precious edelweiss. Thinking a replacement would cool things down, Kay heads toward a dangerous cliff area in Mountainland to find one.

videos.title: It Is Too Cold, Moris Is Gone
videos.overview: Moris is sick and tired of living in the freezing cold Mountainland. Then one day, when Alf visits Moutainland, he learns of the warm Sunnyland and insists on moving there.

videos.title: How Scary, Operation Ghost Hunt
videos.overview: A spooky rumor about a ghost begins to spread in Railworld.

videos.title: Flash Flood, Kay, Help
videos.overview: Paul, a new railer, must overcome his fear of slides in order to collect energy.

videos.title: Let Me Out, Alf Is Trapped
videos.overview: Stuck in an elevator, Alf must endure Gary's recurring, old tales.

videos.title: Kay vs. Duke, Who's Faster?
videos.overview: Kay and Duke battle it out for the title of fastest train in Railworld.

videos.title: Oh So Shy Railer Augustine
videos.overview: When Augustine goes missing, Genie and Selly go searching for her. But Augustine isn't the only thing missing, Johnny's maracas are also nowhere to be found!

videos.title: Can't Tell, Won't Tell
videos.overview: When Tom finds him self out of commission and unable to make his famous bread, Jeanne volunteers to help out. However, not everyone is so pleased with Jeanne's baking.

videos.title: Emma, The Best Chef in Railworld
videos.overview: When Emma becomes ill and can't make her delicious pies, Genie invents the Almighty Oven to fill in.

videos.title: Rich Loves the Compliments
videos.overview: After Rich is praised for watering Victor's flowers, he goes out of control to get more compliments!

videos.title: Stop Growing, The Vitamin Attack
videos.overview: When Genie invents new growth vitamins, the evil duo Mos and Dos set out to steal it.

videos.title: Good Bye, X Family
videos.overview: When Duke suggests that the troublesome trio be broken up, Mos and Dos hatch a plan to keep the group together.

videos.title: Victor and Duke, The New Best Friends
videos.overview: When Alf and Maxie are caught on thin ice, the gang must resort to Duke's help to save them.

videos.title: Whose Box Is This? Maxie Is On The Way
videos.overview: After Maxie disregards a mysterious package, havoc ensues in an unguarded Watchtower.

videos.title: The Greatest Present For Genie
videos.overview: When Genie's newest experiment keeps failing, Kay brings her a lucky, four-leaf clover.

videos.title: Come Play With Us, Gary
videos.overview: After Gary walks off during a camping trip, Maxie and Kay worry they've hurt his feelings.

videos.title: Stop, No More Pranks
videos.overview: While the Troublesome Trio is out to steal some energyballs, Leo "the prankster" gives them trouble.

videos.title: Where in the World Is Leo, the Tardy-King?
videos.overview: When Leo repeatedly oversleeps and shows up late, Genie invents a special watch to help him stay on time.

videos.title: Alf Can Do It
videos.overview: After Alf hurts himself on another dangerous job, Genie decides to invent him a pair of wings.

videos.title: Genie Genie, We Need You
videos.overview: After Genie temporarily loses her memory, the Troublesome Trio unveils a new device in her absence.

videos.title: Woo-Hooo Fly, X Family, Fly
videos.overview: Unknowingly, the Troublesome Trio saves the day in their new hot air balloon.

videos.title: Bubble Bubble, Bubble Pop
videos.overview: The Troublesome Trio is at it again, this time offering train washes to railers.

videos.title: Happy New Birthday, Johnny
videos.overview: When Johnny feels upset about his birthday, the gang gets together to cheer him up.

videos.title: Exciting Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: After saving Kay from drowning, the Troublesome Trio is given a "special card": one that can be used when they're in need of Kay's help.

videos.title: Joseph, The Sunnyland Bookworm
videos.overview: After Joseph stirs up trouble with his reading addiction, he and Andre hatch a plan to create a mobile library.

videos.title: Don't Stop Running, Waterpark Energyball Race
videos.overview: The Railwatchers use their special talents to help Eddie's team prepare for the upcoming "Energy Ball Competition".

videos.title: TrainX's Latest Funny Experiment
videos.overview: A huge explosion causes Master X and Mos to switch bodies!

videos.title: Finally, Louie's Railer Sculpture
videos.overview: When Louie's sculpture is ruined by mysteriously appearing tornadoes, Alf must use Genie's new Blending Ball to save the day.

videos.title: The Crisis Begins, Tomato Tree Is In Danger
videos.overview: When Railworld suffers from a drought, Genie invents a "Floaty Spray" to help out.

videos.title: Beware, The Shadow Is Coming
videos.overview: As the Shadow Energy approaches, Victor uncovers a long lost secret from the ancestors.

videos.title: Where There's A Will, There's A Rainbow Energyball
videos.overview: When the Shadow Energy collides with the Energy Volcano, an unexpected combination of the five good energies is discovered.

videos.title: Railworld Is In Danger, Railwatch To The Rescue
videos.overview: As Genie races to finish the Rainbow Balls, Tony, the secret guardian of Mountainland, explains how the Energy Volcano is the last weapon needed to defeat the Shadow Energy.
